misconfigurations.name: Missing: Strict-Transport-Security (HSTS)
misconfigurations.description: Missing HSTS header -- site vulnerable to protocol downgrade and man-in-the-middle attacks

misconfigurations.name: Missing: Content-Security-Policy (CSP)
misconfigurations.description: Missing Content-Security-Policy header -- no restrictions on resource loading, increasing XSS impact

misconfigurations.name: Missing: X-XSS-Protection
misconfigurations.description: Missing X-XSS-Protection header -- legacy browsers lack reflected XSS filter

misconfigurations.name: Missing: Referrer-Policy
misconfigurations.description: Missing Referrer-Policy header -- sensitive URL paths may leak to third parties via Referer header

misconfigurations.name: Missing: Permissions-Policy
misconfigurations.description: Missing Permissions-Policy header -- browser features (camera, microphone, geolocation) unrestricted

misconfigurations.name: No Rate Limiting on /login
misconfigurations.description: Authentication endpoint http://host.docker.internal:3000/login accepted 25 rapid requests without returning 429. Missing rate limiting enables credential brute-force and stuffing attacks.

misconfigurations.name: Admin Endpoint Accessible Without Auth: /admin
misconfigurations.description: Administrative endpoint http://host.docker.internal:3000/admin is accessible without authentication (returned HTTP 200 with 9393 bytes). This may expose sensitive data, debug info, or admin functionality.
